messages:
Alex K: FYI — after swapping to the newer CUDA kernels on prod, I'm seeing token-level p50 and p95 creep on cross-region routed requests. Not all routes, mostly requests that fall back from eu-west -> us-west. :thinking:
Maria S: can you paste the perf profile / flamegraph? suspect batching or kernel selector change.
Alex K: quick hotspots from a 60s perf capture below. small but consistent increase in attention kernel wall time.
Alex K: ```
# perf sample (aggregated stacks)
frames: attention_kernel_forward 42%
kv_cache_lookup 18%
kernel_dispatch_overhead 10%
alloc 8%
other 22%
```
Jamal R: hmm. kernel selector should pick `fast_attention_v2` for seq < 512. did selector ever fallback to `compat_attention`? @Alex K can you share the request size histogram?
Alex K: prom query I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (route, le))` — shows a tail shift starting ~14:03 UTC coincident with the kernel swap.
Sophie L: I'll add per-route KPI panels. We need token-level breakdown: kernel_time, queue_time, kv_time, egress_net_time. Split by region and routing_policy (preferred vs fallback).
Maria S: traces also show cross-region failovers spiking: `routing.failover.count{from_region="eu-west",to_region="us-west"}` is up.
Alex K: dug in — found an edge case: when router triggers failover it strips `x-rw-cache-prefix` header on the forwarded request. That causes KV cache miss storm.
Jamal R: that explains it — KV miss -> more decode/attention work -> higher token latency. what's kv_hit% during the spike?
Alex K: trace-level tags: eu-west preferred routes kv_hit ~= 82%, but when requests hit us-west fallback kv_hit drops to ~14% :grimacing: which matches the latency delta.
Sophie L: concrete next steps: 1) instrument token-level metrics in grafana (prefix_miss, kernel_exec_time, queue_time, net_time), 2) panel for per-route kv_hit% and failover_rate, 3) add alerting for kv_hit < 50% sustained >2m and cross_region_failover > 1/min.
Maria S: +1 on alerts. also recommend a short-lived on-call rotation while we monitor the canary.
Alex K: prepping a minimal router fix to preserve `x-rw-cache-prefix` on forwarded requests. will canary in eu-west only.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout 2026-03-18-1251 (canary: eu-west)
Jamal R: also let's add a small regression test in the runtime CI that simulates selector + routing + cache headers for seq lens [64,128,512] so kernel selection and prefix propagation are validated.
Sophie L: drafting dashboard PR: https://git.internal/redwood/dashboards/pull/82 — includes token-level breakdowns and per-route KPIs. Will mock KV hit gauge and a routing decision heatmap. :ok_hand:
Maria S: thanks, folks. I'll monitor SLOs and flip the alert to P1 if kv_hit stays low post-fix. Re-monitoring now :eyes:
Alex K: will post canary perf capture in this thread once the rollout finishes.
Maria S: ping if any rollback needed.
